title: Two proposals from meteorology: register at EUMETSAT, and redraw GFS
summary: Dinis: two decisions on meteorology/build-on.html: (1) hour-old Meteosat pictures need a person to register with EUMETSAT and accept its licence, and design rule 9 lifted for that source; (2) GFS fields redrawn by us (public domain) need a GRIB decoder run outside the build
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
